text: `ccusage herdr launch` opens the panel as a Herdr tab of its own (`herdr-app do tab.new` with the mod) and says so; otherwise it says why not and exits nonzero: no Herdr home, the mod not installed (pointing to `ccusage herdr install`), no `herdr-app` on PATH, or Herdr's own refusal in Herdr's words.
